profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience working in the financial services industry. Proficient in C++, Python, and JavaScript. Minor experience with machine learning, specifically computer vision, in the manufacturing domain.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Worked directly under the Vice President of Data Science to implement, fine-tune & deploy a PyTorch object detection model to estimate the size of defects in glass
- The deployed solution performed inference on high-resolution (4k) images in less than 1s, with precision & recall of 95%
- Leveraged Azure Blob Storage, Docker & model-assisted labeling to create a large training dataset
- Collaborated on setting up 1/3rd of a data staging pipeline that sped up experiment setup times by more than 50%

Skills: Python, Pytorch, Microsoft Azure, Git, Object Detection, LINUX

educations.schoolName: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

certifications.name: Architecting with Google Compute Engine Specialization
certifications.title: Architecting with Google Compute Engine Specialization

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Part of the core team from 2016-2018.
- Acted as the composer, music director and lead guitarist for seven ensemble theater acts.
- Worked as a stage manager and event manager for the national level festival: "Aarohan: The Cultural Fest." 
- Helped organize book donation drives, marathons, and other charity events for the underprivileged.

- Performed guitar, bass, and mandolin duties for various bands, plays, and ensemble projects.
- Played guitar and mandolin on Piyush Bhisekar's highly acclaimed album: "Hai Bharosa" (2 million+ streams on Spotify).

projects.title: Autonomous Driving
projects.description:
Calculated steering angles of a car using images from a front-facing camera using a Neural Network using Python, Numpy, Scipy and OpenCV
Achieved an RMSE of less than 6 with an average training time of 5 minutes

projects.title: Skyscraper's impact on Climate Change
projects.description:
Used Jupyter Notebooks, Pandas, scikit-learn and LightGBM to measure and visualize the cost of powering large buildings
Handled Kaggle’s large-scale dataset, ASHRAE, with over 20 million entries
